reviewers.summary: FR-APT-03's sticky-override reducers are correct (untouched follows the live suggestion; withModule unconditionally marks touched, even when the picked value equals the current suggestion), validation is non-stale and derived from the current ceiling, Shell's results gate/aria-live untouched, and scope stays within FR-APT-01/02/03/04/05. Two low polish items, both resolved.

findings.summary: Number.isFinite(value) ? value : '' fallback was dead: Number('') is 0, not NaN, so clearing a field pushed 0 into state and rendered "0" instead of blank; the intended empty-field UX never fired.
findings.recommendation: Coerce the empty string explicitly to NaN in onChange so the finite-guard fires as intended.

findings.summary: The range hint (e.g. "2000–5000") was visually associated with the input but not exposed to assistive tech via aria-describedby, so screen-reader users didn't hear the allowed range.
findings.recommendation: Give the hint span an id and include it in the input's aria-describedby, alongside the error id when invalid.

reviewers.summary: openspec validate apartment-input --strict: PASS. All five owned IDs implemented, tested, and spec-compliant — FR-APT-01/02 bounds+defaults, FR-APT-03's three spec scenarios (untouched-follows, sticky, default-700) all covered by app-state.test.ts, FR-APT-04 inline validation wiring, FR-APT-05 no-submit synchronous recompute. No scope drift into room-input/module-summary/mode-toggle; no new dependency; all 9 consumed i18n keys pre-existed (verified against locales/*.json). 50/50 tests pass.

In-memory-only state (BC-PRIVACY-01/TC-DATA-01), no unsafe rendering, hostile numeric input (Infinity/NaN/huge/negative) through the suggestModule/gcd keystroke path terminates safely (Euclid is O(log n), no unbounded loop, no prototype pollution). package.json/lockfile unchanged.
